verdict.rationale: Babylon.js's own docs list "actions" as part of its scene graph and mention scene interaction through behaviors and mesh picking. That hints at an engine-native way to attach actions to events, but the evidence is only a passing feature-list mention. Nothing describes how rules are defined, which event triggers exist, or what actions can run. missing for 10: documentation of a rule or trigger definition mechanism (event types, conditions, action catalog), any non-code or declarative way to author rules for AI-native users, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
